data.body: DX-bug-repro-bundle found that ddflow keeps no session or hook command log (the post_tool hook does nothing, api/setup.py _on_nothing). The bundle lists the agent's latest log events instead and says so. A bounded, redacted, git-ignored ring log under .ddflow/local/ written by the CLI entry point and the post_tool hook would give 'the last N ddflow commands with exit codes and output tails'.
data.title: Record the commands a session ran (argv, exit code, output tail) so a repro bundle can list the last N

data.body: DX-bug-repro-bundle ships the bundle on bug found (CLI + MCP, config-driven) and show/claim print. Left: (1) a failing gate files its bundle when asked (api/ci.py already calls bug_found so ci gets one; other gates, api/gates.py, were being edited by other agents); (2) test, repro_cmd and repro_capture are CLI-only because tools/list has ~58 bytes of headroom; give MCP a compact way once the budget allows; (3) bug show verb deliberately not added.
data.title: Repro bundle from a failing gate, and --test/--repro-cmd over MCP and in the claim answer
